purpose: Reconnect local web app and measure a larger real repository through the actual browser workflow
chrome_observation: Existing Chrome tab first showed connection refused because the server was stopped. After server startup, Chrome automation showed ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT. HTTP health and the in-app browser succeeded. No Chrome security settings were changed; blocking cause was not established.
enter_behavior_verified: Pressing Enter in the repository URL field submits source import. Analysis starts only after scope/language confirmation and pressing the separate analysis button.

job.scope: All imported folders, C# only; includes engine, modules, tools and tests; not all language or asset files
job.import_timing_method: Ready job.json filesystem modification timestamp minus job.created_at, read before the analysis request
job.browser_observation: Analysis complete 100% for selected scope; 30 hotspot rows and 150 graph nodes rendered

limits_confirmed_from_code.note: Limits are safety ceilings, not a guarantee that all repositories below them are analyzable. Large-source performance depends on language, syntax, settings, hardware and network.

interpretation: No parse/extraction failures were observed for the selected C# input. Complete 100% is a processing status, not accuracy, bug detection rate, whole-game understanding or a build guarantee. C# project settings and external DLLs are not automatically loaded.
changes: Only normal new web job input/results and this verification record were created. No application source changes, Git commits, pushes, browser security changes, AI calls or final submission artifacts.
